description_en: Queries the list of user groups by calling the ListGroups operation
description_zh: 调用ListGroups接口查询用户组列表
name: ListGroups

parameters.help_en:
The token for querying the next page of results. You do not need to specify `Marker` for the first API call.

If the total number of returned entries exceeds the `MaxItems` limit during the first API call, the data is truncated and only `MaxItems` entries are returned. In this case, the `IsTruncated` response parameter is `true` and a `Marker` is returned. You can use the `Marker` returned from the previous call to continue calling the API with the other request parameters unchanged to query the truncated data. You can repeat this process until `IsTruncated` is `false`, which indicates that all data has been queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`Marker`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxItems`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxItems`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`Marker`。您可以使用上一次返回的`Marker`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法经过多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`时，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items

CreateDate.description_en: The creation time in UTC. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateDate.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

UpdateDate.description_en: The update time in UTC. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
UpdateDate.description_zh: 更新时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the returned results are truncated. Valid values:

true
false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true
false

Marker.description_en:
The token for querying the next page of results.
This parameter is returned only when `IsTruncated` is `true`
Marker.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。
只有`IsTruncated`为`true`时，才显示该参数
